articles.title: A Faulty Approach to Homework
articles.topic: 洛杉矶家庭作业新政的缺陷
articles.source: 2012 年考研英语（二）Text 1 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Homework has never been terribly popular with students and even many parents, but in recent years it has been particularly scorned.
sentences.cn: 家庭作业在学生甚至许多家长中从来都算不上很受欢迎，但近年来它更是备受责难。

sentences.en: School districts across the country, most recently Los Angeles Unified, are revising their thinking on this educational ritual.
sentences.cn: 全国各地的学区——最近的是洛杉矶联合学区——正在重新审视对这一教育惯例的看法。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, L.A. Unified has produced an inflexible policy which mandates that with the exception of some advanced courses, homework may no longer count for more than 10% of a student's academic grade.
sentences.cn: 遗憾的是，洛杉矶联合学区出台了一项毫无弹性的政策，规定除某些高级课程外，家庭作业在学生学业成绩中所占比重不得再超过 10%。

sentences.en: This rule is meant to address the difficulty that students from impoverished or chaotic homes might have in completing their homework.
sentences.cn: 这一规定旨在解决来自贫困或混乱家庭的学生在完成家庭作业时可能遇到的困难。

sentences.en: But the policy is unclear and contradictory.
sentences.cn: 但这项政策既含糊又自相矛盾。

sentences.en: Certainly, no homework should be assigned that students cannot complete on their own or that they cannot do without expensive equipment.
sentences.cn: 诚然，凡是学生无法独立完成、或没有昂贵设备就做不了的作业，都不应该布置。

sentences.en: But if the district is essentially giving a pass to students who do not do their homework because of complicated family lives, it is going riskily close to the implication that standards need to be lowered for poor children.
sentences.cn: 但如果学区实际上是在放过那些因家庭情况复杂而不做作业的学生，那它就危险地趋近这样一种暗示：对贫困孩子应当降低标准。

sentences.en: District administrators say that homework will still be a part of schooling; teachers are allowed to assign as much of it as they want.
sentences.cn: 学区管理者表示，家庭作业仍将是学校教育的一部分；教师想布置多少就可以布置多少。

sentences.en: But with homework counting for no more than 10% of their grades, students can easily skip half their homework and see very little difference on their report cards.
sentences.cn: 但既然家庭作业在成绩中的占比不超过 10%，学生大可以逃掉一半作业，而成绩单上几乎看不出差别。

sentences.en: Some students might do well on state tests without completing their homework, but what about the students who performed well on the tests and did their homework?
sentences.cn: 有些学生不做作业也能在州统考中考得不错，但那些统考成绩好、作业也做了的学生又当如何解释呢？

sentences.en: It is quite possible that the homework helped.
sentences.cn: 很有可能正是家庭作业帮了忙。

sentences.en: Yet rather than empowering teachers to find what works best for their students, the policy imposes a flat, across-the-board rule.
sentences.cn: 然而，这项政策没有赋权教师去寻找最适合自己学生的做法，而是强加了一条一刀切的死板规定。

sentences.en: At the same time, the policy addresses none of the truly thorny questions about homework.
sentences.cn: 与此同时，该政策没有触及任何关于家庭作业的真正棘手的问题。

sentences.en: If the district finds homework to be unimportant to its students' academic achievement, it should move to reduce or eliminate the assignments, not make them count for almost nothing.
sentences.cn: 如果学区认定家庭作业对学生的学业成绩无关紧要，就应当着手减少乃至取消作业，而不是让它几乎不计入成绩。

sentences.en: Conversely, if homework matters, it should account for a significant portion of the grade.
sentences.cn: 反之，如果家庭作业确实重要，它就应当在成绩中占据相当大的比重。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, this policy does nothing to ensure that the homework students receive is meaningful or appropriate to their age and the subject, or that teachers are not assigning more than they are willing to review and correct.
sentences.cn: 同时，这项政策也丝毫不能确保学生所领到的作业是有意义的、切合其年龄和学科的，也不能确保教师布置的量不超出他们愿意批改的范围。

sentences.en: The homework rules should be put on hold while the school board, which is responsible for setting educational policy, looks into the matter and conducts public hearings.
sentences.cn: 家庭作业新规应当暂缓实施，由负责制定教育政策的学校董事会调查此事并举行公开听证会。

sentences.en: It is not too late for L.A. Unified to do homework right.
sentences.cn: 洛杉矶联合学区现在把家庭作业这门功课做好，还为时不晚。

questions.stem: It is implied in Paragraph 1 that nowadays homework _____.
questions.stem_cn: 第一段暗示，如今的家庭作业______。

options.B: is gaining more preferences
options.C: is no longer an educational ritual
options.D: is not required for advanced courses

options_cn.B: 正赢得更多青睐
options_cn.C: 不再是一种教育惯例
options_cn.D: 高级课程不再要求做作业

questions.explanation: 定位首段①句：作业从未真正受学生和家长欢迎，"近年来更是备受责难（particularly scorned）"。nowadays 对应 in recent years，receiving more criticism 对应 been particularly scorned，A 正确。B 与文意相反；C 曲解——原文称作业为"教育惯例"，并未说它不再是惯例；D 断章取义，10% 新规只是豁免部分高级课程，并非高级课程不要求作业。

questions.stem: L.A. Unified has made the rule about homework mainly because poor students _____.
questions.stem_cn: 洛杉矶联合学区制定家庭作业新规，主要是因为贫困学生______。

options.A: tend to have moderate expectations for their education
options.B: have asked for a different educational standard
options.C: may have problems finishing their homework
options.D: have voiced their complaints about homework

options_cn.A: 往往对自己的教育期望不高
options_cn.B: 要求采用不同的教育标准
options_cn.C: 完成家庭作业可能有困难
options_cn.D: 对家庭作业大发抱怨

questions.explanation: 由 poor students 与原文 impoverished、poor children 的对应定位第二段首句：这一规定旨在解决贫困或混乱家庭的学生完成作业时可能遇到的困难，C 正确（have problems finishing 对应 difficulty...in completing）。A、B、D 均无文中依据。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 3, one problem with the policy is that it may _____.
questions.stem_cn: 根据第三段，这项政策存在的一个问题是它可能______。

options.A: result in students' indifference to their report cards
options.B: undermine the authority of state tests
options.D: discourage students from doing homework

options_cn.A: 导致学生对成绩单漠不关心
options_cn.B: 削弱州统考的权威性
options_cn.C: 限制教师在教育中的权力
options_cn.D: 打击学生做作业的积极性

questions.explanation: 定位第三段②句：作业占成绩不超过 10%，学生大可逃掉一半作业而成绩单几乎无变化，可推知新政会降低学生做作业的积极性，D 正确。A 混淆——学生不在乎的是作业而非成绩单；B 州考权威性无从谈起；C 夸大其辞，原文只说政策未赋权教师安排作业，并非"限制教师教育权力"。

questions.stem: As mentioned in Paragraph 4, a key question unanswered about homework is whether _____.
questions.stem_cn: 如第四段所述，家庭作业悬而未决的一个关键问题是______。

options.B: it counts much in schooling
options.C: it places extra burdens on teachers
options.D: it is important for grades

options_cn.B: 它在学校教育中是否重要
options_cn.C: 它是否给教师增加额外负担
options_cn.D: 它是否对成绩重要

questions.explanation: 定位第四段①②③句：政策未解决真正棘手的问题——若作业对学业不重要就该减少或取消，若重要就该在成绩中占大头，即"作业在学校教育中是否重要"这一根本问题悬而未决，B 正确。A、D 只是该问题假设分支的一面；C 对应④句教师批改负担，那只是政策未保证的事项之一，并非关键问题。

questions.stem: A suitable title for this text could be _____.
questions.stem_cn: 适合本文的标题是______。

options.B: A Welcomed Policy for Poor Students
options.D: Wrong Interpretations of an Educational Policy

options_cn.A: 对待家庭作业的错误方法
options_cn.B: 一项受贫困学生欢迎的政策
options_cn.C: 关于家庭作业的棘手问题
options_cn.D: 对一项教育政策的错误解读

questions.explanation: 首段引出洛杉矶作业新政，第二至四段逐层剖析其含糊矛盾、打击积极性、回避核心问题等弊端，末段建议暂缓实施，通篇批评这一政策的失当，A 切合主旨。B 与文章批评立场相反；C 只覆盖第四段内容；D 文章批评的是政策本身而非他人对政策的解读。

articles.title: Pretty in Pink: Marketing to Girls
articles.topic: 粉色如何被营销塑造为女孩的颜色
articles.source: 2012 年考研英语（二）Text 2 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Pretty in pink: adult women do not remember being so obsessed with the colour, yet it is pervasive in our young girls' lives.
sentences.cn: 粉红俏佳人：成年女性不记得自己曾如此痴迷于这种颜色，然而它却弥漫在如今小女孩们的生活中。

sentences.en: It is not that pink is intrinsically bad, but it is such a tiny slice of the rainbow and, though it may celebrate girlhood in one way, it also repeatedly and firmly fuses girls' identity to appearance.
sentences.cn: 倒不是说粉色本身有什么不好，但它只是彩虹中极小的一部分；虽然它在某种程度上颂扬了少女气质，却也一再地、牢牢地把女孩的身份与外表捆绑在一起。

sentences.en: Then it presents that connection, even among two-year-olds, between girls as not only innocent but as evidence of innocence.
sentences.cn: 进而，甚至在两岁幼儿中间，它就把女孩之间的这种关联呈现为不仅是天真无邪的，更是天真无邪的证明。

sentences.en: Looking around, I despaired at the singular lack of imagination about girls' lives and interests.
sentences.cn: 环顾四周，我对人们在女孩生活与兴趣问题上极度缺乏想象力感到绝望。

sentences.en: Girls' attraction to pink may seem unavoidable, somehow encoded in their DNA, but according to Jo Paoletti, an associate professor of American Studies, it is not.
sentences.cn: 女孩对粉色的喜爱似乎不可避免，仿佛以某种方式写进了她们的 DNA，但据美国研究学副教授乔·保莱蒂所言，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Children were not colour-coded at all until the early 20th century: in the era before domestic washing machines all babies wore white as a practical matter, since the only way of getting clothes clean was to boil them.
sentences.cn: 直到 20 世纪初，儿童衣着根本没有颜色区分：在家用洗衣机出现之前的年代，出于实用考虑所有婴儿都穿白色，因为把衣服洗干净的唯一办法就是煮沸。

sentences.en: What's more, both boys and girls wore what were thought of as gender-neutral dresses.
sentences.cn: 而且，男孩女孩穿的都是当时被认为不分性别的连衣裙。

words.meaning: adj. 不分性别的，中性的

sentences.en: When nursery colours were introduced, pink was actually considered the more masculine colour, a pastel version of red, which was associated with strength.
sentences.cn: 当幼儿专属色被引入时，粉色实际上被认为是更男性化的颜色——它是红色的淡雅版本，而红色与力量联系在一起。

sentences.en: Blue, with its intimations of the Virgin Mary, constancy and faithfulness, symbolised femininity.
sentences.cn: 而蓝色因让人联想到圣母玛利亚、坚贞与忠诚，象征着女性气质。

sentences.en: It was not until the mid-1980s, when amplifying age and sex differences became a dominant children's marketing strategy, that pink fully came into its own, when it began to seem inherently attractive to girls, part of what defined them as female, at least for the first few critical years.
sentences.cn: 直到 20 世纪 80 年代中期，放大年龄与性别差异成为儿童市场营销的主导策略，粉色才真正大行其道：它开始显得对女孩有一种天然的吸引力，成为界定她们女性身份的一部分——至少在最初关键的几年里如此。

words.meaning: 词组：大放异彩，进入全盛期

sentences.en: I had not realised how profoundly marketing trends dictated our perception of what is natural to kids, including our core beliefs about their psychological development.
sentences.cn: 我此前未曾意识到，营销趋势多么深刻地左右着我们对孩子天性的认知，包括我们关于儿童心理发展的核心信念。

sentences.en: Take the toddler.
sentences.cn: 以"学步儿童"为例。

sentences.en: I assumed that phase was something experts developed after years of research into children's behaviour: wrong.
sentences.cn: 我原以为这个阶段概念是专家们经过多年儿童行为研究才提出的：错了。

sentences.en: Turns out, according to Daniel Cook, a historian of childhood consumerism, it was popularised as a marketing trick by clothing manufacturers in the 1930s.
sentences.cn: 事实证明，据儿童消费主义史学家丹尼尔·库克所言，它是 20 世纪 30 年代被服装制造商当作营销伎俩推广开来的。

sentences.en: Trade publications counselled department stores that, in order to increase sales, they should create a "third stepping stone" between infant wear and older kids' clothes.
sentences.cn: 行业刊物建议百货商店：为了增加销量，应在婴儿装与大童装之间创造一个"第三级跳板"。

sentences.en: It was only after "toddler" became a common shoppers' term that it evolved into a broadly accepted developmental stage.
sentences.cn: 只有在"学步儿童"成为购物者的常用词之后，它才演变为一个被广泛接受的发育阶段。

sentences.en: Splitting kids, or adults, into ever-tinier categories has proved a sure-fire way to boost profits.
sentences.cn: 把儿童乃至成人分成越来越细的类别，已被证明是提高利润的万无一失之法。

sentences.en: And one of the easiest ways to segment a market is to magnify gender differences – or invent them where they did not previously exist.
sentences.cn: 而细分市场最简便的方法之一，就是放大性别差异——或者在原本不存在差异的地方凭空制造差异。

questions.stem: By saying "it is…the rainbow" (Line 3, Para. 1), the author means pink _____.
questions.stem_cn: 作者说"它只是彩虹中极小的一部分"（第一段第 3 行），意思是粉色______。

options.A: cannot explain girls' lack of imagination
options.B: should not be associated with girls' innocence
options.C: should not be the sole representation of girlhood
options.D: cannot influence girls' lives and interests

options_cn.A: 无法解释女孩缺乏想象力的原因
options_cn.B: 不应与女孩的天真联系在一起
options_cn.C: 不应成为少女气质的唯一象征
options_cn.D: 不能影响女孩的生活和兴趣

questions.explanation: 定位首段②句：but 前说"倒不是粉色本身不好"，其后指出粉色只是彩虹极小的一部分、虽能在某一方面颂扬少女气质却把女孩身份与外表捆绑——可推知粉色不能代表女孩的全部特质，少女气质应有粉色之外的更多象征，C 最贴近文意（sole 对应 in one way，representation of girlhood 对应 celebrate girlhood）。A 张冠李戴，缺乏想象力的是大人；B、D 偏离该句语义。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 2, which of the following is true of colours?
questions.stem_cn: 根据第二段，关于颜色下列哪项说法正确？

options.A: Colours are encoded in girls' DNA.
options.B: Blue used to be regarded as the colour for girls.
options.D: Pink used to be a neutral colour in symbolising genders.

options_cn.A: 颜色偏好写在女孩的 DNA 里
options_cn.B: 蓝色曾被视为女孩的颜色
options_cn.C: 婴儿更喜欢白色
options_cn.D: 粉色曾是象征性别的中性色

questions.explanation: 定位第二段⑤句：蓝色因让人联想到圣母玛利亚、坚贞与忠诚而象征女性气质，即蓝色曾被用来代表女孩，B 正确（the colour for girls 对应 symbolised femininity）。A 与该段首句"事实并非如此"相反；C 曲解——婴儿穿白色是出于洗涤实用而非偏好；D 错误，粉色曾被视为更男性化的颜色而非中性色。

questions.stem: The author suggests that our perception of children's psychological development was much influenced by _____.
questions.stem_cn: 作者暗示，我们对儿童心理发展的认知在很大程度上受到______的影响。

options.B: the marketing of products for children
options.D: studies of childhood consumption

options_cn.B: 儿童产品的市场营销
options_cn.C: 对儿童行为的研究
options_cn.D: 对儿童消费的研究

questions.explanation: 定位第三段①句：营销趋势深刻左右着我们对孩子天性的认知，包括关于儿童心理发展的核心信念；随后以"学步儿童"为例——这一阶段概念实为 20 世纪 30 年代服装制造商的营销伎俩，B 正确（much influenced 对应 profoundly dictated，marketing 对应 marketing trends）。A、C 恰是作者原先的错误假设；D 偷换概念，丹尼尔·库克研究的是消费主义史，而非"儿童消费研究"影响认知。

questions.stem: We may learn from Paragraph 4 that department stores were advised to _____.
questions.stem_cn: 由第四段可知，百货商店被建议______。

options.B: attach equal importance to different genders
options.C: focus on infant wear and older kids' clothes
options.D: create some common shoppers' terms

options_cn.A: 把消费者划分成更小的群体
options_cn.B: 对不同性别给予同等重视
options_cn.C: 专注于婴儿装和大童装
options_cn.D: 创造一些购物者常用语

questions.explanation: 定位第四段①③句：行业刊物建议百货商店在婴儿装与大童装之间创造"第三级跳板"，③句进一步指出把人分成越来越细的类别是提高利润的万无一失之法——即建议商店细分消费群体，A 正确（classify...into smaller groups 对应 create a "third stepping stone" 与 splitting...into ever-tinier categories）。B 无据且与末句"放大性别差异"相悖；C 遗漏关键的"第三级"；D 因果颠倒，"学步儿童"成为常用语是结果而非建议。

questions.stem: It can be concluded that girls' attraction to pink seems to be _____.
questions.stem_cn: 可以得出结论：女孩对粉色的喜爱似乎是______。

options.B: clearly explained by their inborn tendency
options.D: well interpreted by psychological experts

options_cn.A: 被服装制造商完全理解的
options_cn.B: 可由天生倾向清楚解释的
options_cn.C: 主要由逐利商人强加的
options_cn.D: 被心理学专家诠释得很好的

questions.explanation: 纵观全文：开篇描述粉色主宰女孩生活的现状，第二段否定"DNA 天生说"，指出粉色大行其道始于 80 年代放大性别差异的营销策略，三、四段进一步揭示营销为逐利细分市场、放大甚至凭空制造性别差异——女孩爱粉色主要是逐利商人营销策略强加的结果，C 正确。B 被第二段明确否定；A、D 无文中依据。

articles.title: Gene Patents and the Courts
articles.source: 2012 年考研英语（二）Text 3 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: In 2010, a federal judge shook America's biotech industry to its core.
sentences.cn: 2010 年，一位联邦法官把美国生物技术产业震撼到了根基。

sentences.en: Companies had won patents for isolated DNA for decades – by 2005 some 20% of human genes were patented.
sentences.cn: 几十年来公司们一直在为分离出的 DNA 申请到专利——到 2005 年，约 20% 的人类基因已被申专利。

sentences.en: But in March 2010 a judge ruled that genes were unpatentable.
sentences.cn: 但 2010 年 3 月，一位法官裁定基因不可申请专利。

sentences.en: Executives were violently agitated.
sentences.cn: 高管们反应激烈，十分不安。

sentences.en: The Biotechnology Industry Organisation (BIO), a trade group, assured members that this was just a "preliminary step" in a longer battle.
sentences.cn: 行业团体生物技术产业组织（BIO）向成员保证，这只是一场更漫长战斗中的"初步一步"。

sentences.en: On July 29th they were relieved, at least temporarily.
sentences.cn: 7 月 29 日，他们总算松了口气，至少是暂时如此。

sentences.en: A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision, ruling that Myriad Genetics could indeed hold patents to two genes that help forecast a woman's risk of breast cancer.
sentences.cn: 一家联邦上诉法院推翻了先前的裁决，裁定 Myriad Genetics 公司确实可以拥有两个基因的专利，这两个基因有助于预测女性患乳腺癌的风险。

sentences.en: The chief executive of Myriad, a company in Utah, said the ruling was a blessing to firms and patients alike.
sentences.cn: 位于犹他州的 Myriad 公司首席执行官称，这一裁决对企业和患者而言都是一件幸事。

sentences.en: But as companies continue their attempts at personalised medicine, the courts will remain rather busy.
sentences.cn: 但随着企业继续尝试个性化医疗，法院将依旧相当忙碌。

sentences.en: The Myriad case itself is probably not over.
sentences.cn: Myriad 案本身可能还没有结束。

sentences.en: Critics make three main arguments against gene patents: a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented; gene patents suppress innovation rather than reward it; and patents' monopolies restrict access to genetic tests such as Myriad's.
sentences.cn: 反对者提出三大反对基因专利的理由：基因是自然的产物，故不可申专利；基因专利压制创新而非奖励创新；专利垄断限制了对 Myriad 这类基因检测的使用。

sentences.en: A growing number seem to agree.
sentences.cn: 赞同这些观点的人似乎越来越多。

sentences.en: Last year a federal task-force urged reform for patents related to genetic tests.
sentences.cn: 去年，一个联邦专项小组敦促对与基因检测相关的专利进行改革。

sentences.en: In October the Department of Justice filed a brief in the Myriad case, arguing that an isolated DNA molecule "is no less a product of nature…than are cotton fibres that have been separated from cotton seeds."
sentences.cn: 10 月，司法部在 Myriad 案中提交了一份案情摘要，主张分离出的 DNA 分子"与从棉籽中分离出的棉纤维一样，同样是自然的产物"。

sentences.en: Despite the appeals court's decision, big questions remain unanswered.
sentences.cn: 尽管上诉法院做出了裁决，一些大问题仍悬而未决。

sentences.en: For example, it is unclear whether the sequencing of a whole genome violates the patents of individual genes within it.
sentences.cn: 例如，尚不清楚对整个基因组进行测序是否侵犯了其中单个基因的专利。

sentences.en: The case may yet reach the Supreme Court.
sentences.cn: 这一案件仍可能上诉至最高法院。

sentences.en: As the industry advances, however, other suits may have an even greater impact.
sentences.cn: 然而，随着产业的发展，其他诉讼可能产生更大的影响。

sentences.en: Companies are unlikely to file many more patents for human DNA molecules – most are already patented or in the public domain.
sentences.cn: 公司们不太可能再为人类 DNA 分子申请更多专利——大多数已被申专利或已进入公有领域。

sentences.en: Firms are now studying how genes interact, looking for correlations that might be used to determine the causes of disease or predict a drug's efficacy.
sentences.cn: 企业们现在正在研究基因如何相互作用，寻找可能用于确定疾病成因或预测药物疗效的关联。

sentences.en: Companies are eager to win patents for "connecting the dots," explains Hans Sauer, a lawyer for the BIO.
sentences.cn: BIO 的律师汉斯·索尔解释说，公司们渴望为"将线索串联起来"申请专利。

words.meaning: 词组：串联线索，看出内在联系

sentences.en: Their success may be determined by a suit related to this issue, brought by the Mayo Clinic, which the Supreme Court will hear in its next term.
sentences.cn: 他们能否成功，或许取决于与此相关的一起诉讼——该诉讼由梅约诊所提起，最高法院将在下一会期审理。

sentences.en: The BIO recently held a convention which included sessions to coach lawyers on the shifting landscape for patents.
sentences.cn: BIO 最近召开了一次大会，其中设有培训环节，指导律师应对不断变化的专利局面。

sentences.en: Each meeting was packed.
sentences.cn: 每一场会议都座无虚席。

words.meaning: adj. 挤满的，座无虚席的

questions.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 1 that the biotech companies would like _____.
questions.stem_cn: 由第一段可知，生物技术公司希望______。

options.B: the BIO to issue a warning
options.D: judges to rule out gene patenting

options_cn.B: BIO 发出警告
options_cn.C: 他们的高管积极行动
options_cn.D: 法官废除基因专利

questions.explanation: 第一段指出：法官裁定"基因不可申专利"令生物科技公司极度不安，BIO 向成员保证这只是持久战的第一步，可反向推断公司希望"基因可申专利"，A 正确。B 因果颠倒，BIO 是安抚而非发警告；C 无关；D 与公司意愿相反。

questions.stem: Those who are against gene patents believe that _____.
questions.stem_cn: 反对基因专利的人认为______。

options.B: only man-made products are patentable
options.C: patents on genes depend much on innovation
options.D: courts should restrict access to genetic tests

options_cn.B: 只有人造产品才可申专利
options_cn.C: 基因专利很大程度上取决于创新
options_cn.D: 法院应限制基因检测的使用

questions.explanation: 定位第三段③句：反对者三大理由之一是"基因是自然的产物，故不可申专利"，B 项是其反向同义表达（only man-made products are patentable 对应 a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented），故正确。A 无据；C 与"专利压制创新"相反；D 曲解第三条理由，反对者是认为专利垄断限制了检测使用、应扩大使用，而非主张法院限制检测。

questions.stem: According to Hans Sauer, companies are eager to win patents for _____.
questions.stem_cn: 据汉斯·索尔所言，公司们渴望为______申请专利。

options.B: establishing disease correlations
options.D: identifying human DNA

options_cn.B: 建立疾病关联
options_cn.C: 绘制基因图谱
options_cn.D: 识别人类 DNA

questions.explanation: 定位第五段末句：公司渴望为"connecting the dots"申专利；回看上一句可知企业正研究基因如何相互作用，可推知 connecting the dots 即指发现基因间的相互作用，A 正确（gene interactions 对应 how genes interact）。B 是寻找关联的目的之一，非专利对象本身；C 曲解 connecting the dots；D 与本句"不再为 DNA 分子申专利"相左。

questions.stem: By saying "Each meeting was packed" (Line 4, Para. 6), the author means that _____.
questions.stem_cn: 作者说"每一场会议都座无虚席"（第六段第 4 行），意思是______。

options.B: the BIO was a powerful organisation
options.C: gene patenting was a great concern
options.D: lawyers were keen to attend conventions

options_cn.B: BIO 是个强大的组织
options_cn.C: 基因专利是一个重大关切
options_cn.D: 律师们热衷于参加大会

questions.explanation: 所考句连同上一句共同说明：BIO 召开会议培训律师应对不断变化的基因专利局面，而每场会议都座无虚席，可见无论 BIO 还是律师都极为关注基因专利问题，即基因专利是个重大问题，C 正确。A、B 无关；D 把“座无虚席”片面理解为“律师热衷开会”，偏离作者强调的“关注度”。

questions.stem: Generally speaking, the author's attitude toward gene patenting is _____.
questions.stem_cn: 总体而言，作者对基因专利的态度是______。

options.B: supportive
options.D: objective

options_cn.B: 支持的
options_cn.C: 轻蔑的
options_cn.D: 客观的

questions.explanation: 纵观全文，作者只是客观介绍基因专利相关裁决及引发的反响，陈述支持方（生物科技产业）与反对方的观点，自始至终未表明自己的立场，故 D 最为准确。generally speaking 一词也提示需着眼全文。A、B、C 均属主观倾向，无文中依据。

articles.title: An Era of High Joblessness
articles.topic: 高失业时代对社会的重塑
articles.source: 2012 年考研英语（二）Text 4 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: The great recession may be over, but this era of high joblessness is probably beginning.
sentences.cn: 大衰退或许已经结束，但这个高失业率的时代可能才刚刚开始。

sentences.en: Before it ends, it will likely change the life course and character of a generation of young adults.
sentences.cn: 在它结束之前，它很可能会改变一代年轻人的人生轨迹与性格。

sentences.en: And ultimately, it is likely to reshape our politics, our culture, and the character of our society for years.
sentences.cn: 而且最终，它很可能在未来多年重塑我们的政治、文化以及社会的性格。

sentences.en: No one tries harder than the jobless to find silver linings in this national economic disaster.
sentences.cn: 在这场全国性经济灾难中，没有谁比失业者更努力地去寻找一线希望。

words.meaning: 词组：寻找一线希望（黑暗中的光明）

sentences.en: Many said that unemployment, while extremely painful, had improved them in some ways: they had become less materialistic and more financially prudent; they were more aware of the struggles of others.
sentences.cn: 许多人说，失业虽然极其痛苦，却在某些方面使他们有所进步：他们变得不那么拜金，理财上更加谨慎；他们更能体会他人的艰辛。

words.meaning: adj. 拜金的，物质主义的

sentences.en: In limited respects, perhaps the recession will leave society better off.
sentences.cn: 在有限的方面，这场衰退也许会让社会变得更好。

sentences.en: At the very least, it has awoken us from our national fever dream of easy riches and bigger houses, and put a necessary end to an era of reckless personal spending.
sentences.cn: 至少，它把我们从全民对一夜暴富和更大房子的狂热美梦中唤醒，并为一个胆大妄为的个人消费时代画上了必要的句号。

words.meaning: adj. 胆大妄为的，鲁莽的

sentences.en: But for the most part, these benefits seem thin, uncertain, and far off.
sentences.cn: 但大体而言，这些好处显得微薄、不确定且遥不可及。

sentences.en: In The Moral Consequences of Economic Growth, the economic historian Benjamin Friedman argues that both inside and outside the U.S., lengthy periods of economic stagnation or decline have almost always left society more mean-spirited and less inclusive, and have usually stopped or reversed the advance of rights and freedoms.
sentences.cn: 在《经济增长的道德后果》一书中，经济史学家本杰明·弗里德曼认为，无论在美国内外，长期的经济停滞或衰退几乎总是使社会变得更加狭隘、包容性更差，并且通常会阻止或逆转权利与自由的进步。

sentences.en: Anti-immigrant sentiment typically increases, as does conflict between races and classes.
sentences.cn: 反移民情绪通常会加剧，种族与阶级之间的冲突也同样如此。

sentences.en: Income inequality usually falls during a recession, but it has not shrunk in this one.
sentences.cn: 经济衰退期间收入不平等通常会下降，但这一次它并未缩小。

words.meaning: v. 缩小（shrink 的过去分词）

sentences.en: Indeed, this period of economic weakness may reinforce class divides, and decrease opportunities to cross them – especially for young people.
sentences.cn: 确实，这一经济疲软时期可能加深阶级鸿沟，并减少跨越鸿沟的机会——尤其是对年轻人而言。

sentences.en: The research of Till Von Wachter, the economist at Columbia University, suggests that not all people graduating into a recession see their life chances dimmed: those with degrees from elite universities catch up fairly quickly to where they otherwise would have been if they had graduated in better times; it is the masses beneath them that are left behind.
sentences.cn: 哥伦比亚大学经济学家蒂尔·冯·瓦克特的研究表明，并非所有在衰退期毕业的人都会看到自己的人生机会变得渺茫：那些拥有名校学位的人会相当快地追上他们若在好年景毕业本应达到的水平；被抛在后面的是他们之下的广大普通人。

sentences.en: In the Internet age, it is particularly easy to see the resentment that has always been hidden within American society.
sentences.cn: 在互联网时代，很容易就能看到那种一直隐藏在美国社会中的怨恨。

sentences.en: More difficult, in the moment, is discerning precisely how these lean times are affecting society's character.
sentences.cn: 而当下更难的，是准确地辨明这些艰难时期究竟如何影响着社会的性格。

sentences.en: In many respects, the U.S. was more socially tolerant entering this recession than at any time in its history, and a variety of national polls on social conflict since then have shown mixed results.
sentences.cn: 在许多方面，美国进入这场衰退时在社会包容度上超过了历史上任何时期，而自那以后关于社会冲突的各种全国性民意调查却结果不一。

sentences.en: We will have to wait and see exactly how these hard times will reshape our social fabric.
sentences.cn: 我们将不得不拭目以待，看这些艰难时期究竟会如何重塑我们的社会结构。

sentences.en: But they certainly will reshape it, and all the more so the longer they extend.
sentences.cn: 但它们无疑会重塑社会结构，而且持续的时间越长，重塑作用就越强。

questions.stem: By saying "to find silver linings" (Line 1, Para. 2) the author suggests that the jobless try to _____.
questions.stem_cn: 作者说"寻找一线希望"（第二段第 1 行），暗示失业者在试图______。

options.B: make profits from the troubled economy
options.D: look on the bright side of the recession

options_cn.B: 从不利的经济中获利
options_cn.C: 探索失业的原因
options_cn.D: 看到经济衰退的积极面

questions.explanation: 短语 to find silver linings 出现在第二段①句，②句句首 Many 指失业者，暗示②句在解释①句：失业者认为失业虽痛苦却以某些方式使人进步，可见失业者以积极视角看待衰退，D 正确（look on the bright side 对应 find silver linings）。A 常识设障，原文未提；B 抽离 materialistic/financially 主观生成"获利"；C 将"价值观进步"曲解为"为失业找原因"。

questions.stem: According to Paragraph 2, the recession has made people _____.
questions.stem_cn: 根据第二段，这场衰退使人们______。

options.B: realize the national dream
options.D: reconsider their lifestyle

options_cn.B: 实现了民族梦
options_cn.C: 挑战自身谨慎度
options_cn.D: 重新思考自身生活方式

questions.explanation: 第二段探讨衰退的积极影响：②句指失业者在价值观和消费观上有所进步（不那么拜金、理财更谨慎），④句指衰退使人们结束胆大妒为的消费，均反映生活方式的重新审视，D 正确。A 把 more aware of the struggles of others 曲解为相互斗争；B、C 均与原文旨意相反或无据。

questions.stem: Benjamin Friedman believes that economic recessions may _____.
questions.stem_cn: 本杰明·弗里德曼认为经济衰退可能______。

options.A: impose a heavier burden on immigrants
options.B: bring out more evils of human nature
options.C: promote the advance of rights and freedoms
options.D: ease conflicts between races and classes

options_cn.B: 使人性中更丑恶的因素凸显
options_cn.C: 推动权利和自由进步
options_cn.D: 缓解种族和阶级间冲突

questions.explanation: 定位第三段：弗里德曼指出长期经济停滞或衰退几乎总使社会变得更狭隘、包容性更差（more mean-spirited and less inclusive），B 是其同义转换（evils of human nature 对应 more mean-spirited and less inclusive）。A 过度推导③句"反移民情绪高涨"；C、D 把"阻止权利自由进步""冲突加剧"反向曲解。

questions.stem: The research of Till Von Wachter suggests that in the recession graduates from elite universities tend to _____.
questions.stem_cn: 蒂尔·冯·瓦克特的研究表明，在衰退中名校毕业生往往______。

options.A: lag behind the others due to decreased opportunities
options.B: catch up quickly with experienced employees
options.C: see their life chances as dimmed as the others'
options.D: recover more quickly than the others

options_cn.A: 因机会减少而落后于他人
options_cn.B: 快速赶上经验丰富的员工
options_cn.C: 和他人一样觉得前景渺茫
options_cn.D: 比其他人恢复得更快

questions.explanation: 定位第四段③句：名校毕业生不像其他人那样觉得前景黄淡，相反会相当快地追上他们若在好年景毕业本应达到的水平，即比其他人恢复得更快，D 正确（catch up fairly quickly 对应 recover more quickly）。A、C 与原文相反，那是普通毕业生的处境；B 无关，未提及与经验员工比较。

questions.stem: The author thinks that the influence of hard times on society is _____.
questions.stem_cn: 作者认为艰难时期对社会的影响是______。

options.B: positive
options.D: destructive

options_cn.B: 积极的
options_cn.C: 确定无疑的
options_cn.D: 毁灭性的

questions.explanation: 末段④句指出想了解衰退重塑社会的具体情况需时间考察，⑤句转而指出"社会结构将被重塑"是毋庸置疑的（they certainly will reshape it），C 与之相符——影响方式与具体情况尚不确定，但影响本身是确定的。A、D 过于绝对；B 只是第二段有限的积极面，非全文总体态度。
